exposure: Low-dose high-frequency onsite clinical mentorship in EmONC
outcome: Proportion of babies born with low APGAR scores
Referral rate for comprehensive emergency obstetric care
cohort: Pregnant women receiving care at two midwife-led maternity care hospitals in rural Kenya
finding: Targeted mentorship of nurse/midwives improves competency in managing pregnancy and childbirth complications, leading to a reduction in intrapartum fetal deaths.
